claims.head: Penalties could cost the Wild
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ power play creates at least their usual 9.0 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Golden Knights’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Wild’s kill is around the middle of the league. The Wild need to stay out of the box.
claims.nums: Vegas 2nd for power play (9.0 expected goals per 60) · Minnesota 22nd for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Golden Knights’ power play has a soft target in the Wild’s kill.

MIN.head: Minnesota faces a real test
MIN.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Minnesota has home ice. Minnesota’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.
